title: FreeCAD ACIS consumer boundary and generated SAB control
scope: Verify the current FreeCAD DXF/DWG import route and ACIS consumer limits.
Cross-check ezdxf's current public ACIS API as a scratch-only faceted SAT/SAB producer.
Refresh the current status and evidentiary scope of LibreDWG #1411 and ACadSharp #1195/#1240.
Refine the plan's FreeCAD platform matrix without turning unsupported stock-importer ACIS into a blocking acceptance condition.

sources.observed: Current documentation describes DWG conversion to DXF followed by a selected C++ or legacy Python importer; documented entity scopes differ, and embedded ACIS/SAT solids are not read by the stock route. Issue #18454 is closed as not planned after the maintainer identified the unsupported content as ACIS solids.
sources.evidenceClass: current project documentation and closed issue; no local application run

sources.observed: The public API documents constructing a body from a mesh and emitting SAT for R2000-R2010 or SAB for R2013/R2018. Loading is limited to known ACIS structures; unsupported records become NONE_ENTITY and data is lost. The project has no ACIS kernel, and mesh extraction is limited to flat polygonal faces.
sources.evidenceClass: project API documentation; no package installation/runtime probe

sources.observed: Open issue #1411 reports generated AC1032 REGION/SAB geometry loss in both conversion directions on LibreDWG 0.14.8593 at 8a1ae76, plus a separate confidential R2018 case. This is version-specific peer evidence and was not independently reproduced.
sources.evidenceClass: primary issue report and source/documentation cross-check; no peer executable run

sources.observed: Issue #1195 remains a report of silent DWG-to-DXF omission of ACIS entities. PR #1240 is open, not deployed, and linked to the issue; the live PR page does not establish a released DXF-writer fix.
sources.evidenceClass: primary issue and pull request status; no branch checkout or runtime test

assessment.planImpact: Split stock FreeCAD platform qualification from ACIS semantic qualification. Use current ezdxf API only as an optional scratch producer for a faceted SAT/SAB carrier; do not count its self-read, mesh projection, or carrier bytes as an independent B-rep result. Retain peer issue reports as version-scoped failure leads.
